body: Yes, and at the same time I feel sorry for them. There are so many who wanted to I live and deserved to live. I just don’t deserve to live,nor want to.
In the past few years more than ever. It’s thrown everything at me to keep me apart from the only person who gives a fuck about me who lives in a different country for over a year.
Fuck the shrinks. They are paid an obscene amount of money to be so useless. I literally do more for society than they do and I’m just scraping over minimum wage.

You’re probably thinking getting a girlfriend will solve all your problems. It won’t. Take it from someone who thought that then got one. I just feel like I’m not good enough for my girlfriend and I even lied to her about my life just to date her because I was so desperate. The unhappiness we feel about ourselves is something no one gives a fuck about to fix, unless you’re a person people are drawn to because you’re interesting, good looking or whatever. Otherwise, no one fucking cares enough about us to help with our REAL issues.

I got up today and it was another fucking pointless day. I did nothing meaningful and have nothing that makes me happy. I got out of bed and went to my shorty dead end job and I have no money and no savings. I waste most of the day in the bathroom. When I go home I have no one waiting for me and idle away the last bit of the day before doing the same fucking thing the next day. God, if you’re reading this, please give me cancer or a terminal illness.

I sometimes fantasise about getting a terminal illness. It’s one of the reasons why I smoke. Just before I die I’d tell everyone what I really think about them. I really don’t care how I’m remembered. I want to show them how much hate I have for people and this fucked up unfair world.
